description: A boat on land, mounted by clicking it with nothing in hand: paddling across stone, ice and blue ice into a wall, backing and turning; teleported (with the player in it) to soul sand and paddled across it; teleported near the edge of a 4-high ledge and driven off onto slime (bouncing); sneaking out.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
